blocks.heading: 01 · Webhook delivery · 6 nodes
blocks.text: A single request path, balanced into two rows of three cards. The second row reads right to left.

blocks.heading: 02 · Document approval · 9 nodes
blocks.text: A three-branch review that rejoins before publication. All branches are logically parallel.

blocks.heading: 03 · Telemetry pipeline · 13 nodes
blocks.text: Three producers feed three signal lanes around a legacy observability monolith. The app still writes logs directly, and alerts call back into legacy configuration.

blocks.heading: 04 · Order fulfillment · 16 nodes
blocks.text: A legacy commerce monolith joins three checks and emits fulfillment events. Cart lookups bypass checkout, reservations retry backward, and operations patch orders directly.

blocks.heading: 05 · Media platform · 20 nodes
blocks.text: Five groups surround a legacy media monolith and three processing lanes. Publishing still writes ingest metadata, transcoding reads the original objects, and monitoring retries the upload queue directly.

blocks.heading: 06 · Subscription matrix · forced crossing
blocks.text: Each of three event streams feeds each of three consumers. These nine direct edges form K₃,₃, so at least one crossing is unavoidable.
